name: Lahore
description: Mughal forts, gardens, the Walled City and some of the best food in Pakistan.

name: Islamabad
description: Green capital at the foot of the Margalla Hills with trails, viewpoints and the Faisal Mosque.

name: Karachi
description: Port city of beaches, colonial architecture, museums and late-night food streets.

name: Multan
description: City of Sufi shrines, blue tile work, mangoes and old bazaars.

name: Peshawar
description: Ancient frontier city of bazaars, Mughal mosques and Gandhara art.

name: Murree
description: Pine-covered hill station with Mall Road, chairlifts and cool summers.

name: Hunza
description: Karakoram valley of forts, apricot orchards, glaciers and Attabad Lake.

name: Skardu
description: Gateway to the Karakoram with lakes, a cold desert and the Deosai plains.

name: Swat
description: Green valley of Buddhist stupas, rivers, orchards and the Malam Jabba slopes.

name: Kalam
description: High Swat valley of forests, rivers and alpine lakes like Mahodand.

name: Bahawalpur
description: Former princely state of white palaces, desert forts and Cholistan.
